ops.title: Canonicalize legacy bare-uvx prefix before classification to enable migration
ops.body: Pre-`--isolated` consumers wired their hooks.json entries as bare `uvx capt-hook` (see `legacy_getaway_hooks_json` in tests/test_pack_lint.py — the historical getaway shape). `pack scaffold` canonicalizes that prefix (`scaffold.canonicalize_prefix`, driven by `LEGACY_PREFIXES`) before running the shared `is_attach_argv`/`is_canonical_run_argv` predicates, so migration strips and replaces those entries while lint's canonical predicates stay strict. Widening lint itself is the wrong fix — canonical strictness is lint's contract; migration tolerance belongs to scaffold's classifier.
